events.text: A caravan from the western regions never reached the city. Its merchant guild offers a reward.

effects.log: Days in the desert wind. You find tracks.
They whisper of a caravan carrying something that was not silk.

events.text: You find the caravan wrecked in a dry gully. The cargo boxes are empty, except one.

ok.log: A sealed jade tablet with strange writing. The guild pays well. (+25 taels)

effects.log: Proper rites for the dead. Then the box.

events.text: A single survivor of the caravan hides in a cave, starving.

effects.log: He says the caravan carried a relic stolen from a western temple.

choices.text: Give him water and ask what happened

effects.log: Raiders in red masks. They knew exactly what they wanted.

events.text: Raiders in red masks attack the search party.

ok.log: They retreat, leaving a red mask behind.

effects.log: Alive to search another day.

events.text: A monk from the west arrives, searching for the stolen relic.

effects.log: Together you track the relic to a merchant's cellar.
He bows deeply and goes on alone.

events.text: The merchant guild wants to sell the relic rather than return it.

choices.text: Return it to the monk secretly

effects.log: The guild never knows. The monk blesses you.
Not your business. It still bothers you.

events.text: A lost camel from the caravan follows you everywhere.

effects.log: It spits at everyone but you.
They give you a small reward. (+5 taels)

ok.log: You reach the oasis, sand in every crease.

fail.log: You get lost for a day.

effects.log: You wait it out, eating sand.

variants: A wall of sand rolls over the road and swallows it.

events.text: A caravan camps outside the village. The camels are the biggest animals you have ever seen.

effects.log: It eats your sleeve too.
Stories of cities of gold and seas of sand.

events.text: A shrine where caravans leave offerings for safe passage.

effects.log: May the road be kind.

choices.text: Read the old caravan names carved there

effects.log: Hundreds of journeys, some that never ended.

events.text: The guild pays the searchers. The survivors' families thank you by name.

choices.text: Give your share to the drivers' widows

effects.log: They will eat this winter.
Honest pay for honest work. (+12 taels)

events.text: Teahouses buzz about the lost caravan. Your part in it grows with every telling.

effects.log: It is less exciting. People prefer the other one.
By spring, you fought a dragon.
